changelog:
Initial release — provides a workflow helper for validated, high-demand PollyReach-style productivity needs:

- Assists users with bug fixes, setup hardening, safety improvements, and creation of related workflows for Clawhub agents.
- Offers concise work plans, checklists, templates, and implementation support tailored to user-defined requirements.
- Emphasizes local-hardware–friendly solutions (scripts, checklists) over cloud-dependent or resource-heavy approaches.
- Outputs include clear verification and validation notes for delivered artifacts.
- Designed to respond to both broad and specific workflow/productivity requests using defined trigger keywords.
